configurePresets.name: nx-arm-gcc
configurePresets.description: Base for all projects, of the neXtBSW tree and of a workspace alike (ARCH-57). Include this file from the CMakePresets.json next to the workspace root CMakeLists.txt: {"include": ["nextbsw/cmake/NxPresets.json"]}. ${sourceDir} is then the workspace (build directory and .venv come from it), ${fileDir} stays this cmake/ folder of the tree. NX_PROJECT selects the project; board, derivative, family and toolchain file follow from it (tools/nxconfig). arm-none-eabi-gcc comes from PATH, NX_ARM_GCC_BIN (environment, the bin folder of the pinned xPack GCC 11.3.1 that `python -m tools.ci setup` fetches) is put in front of it. A build directory whose cached compiler moved or vanished needs `cmake --preset <name> --fresh` (tools/test does that by itself).

configurePresets.name: nx-worktree
configurePresets.description: Only for git worktrees under <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>: builds in %TEMP%/s32k/<name> to stay below the Windows 260-character path limit and uses the .venv of the main repository.
